_comment: Catalog muscle slug -> Z-Anatomy mesh base names (side/variant suffixes .l/.r/.ol/.or/.el/.er matched automatically). render.py colours every mesh whose base name is listed. ⚠ EVERY NAME MUST MATCH A MESH THE ATLAS ACTUALLY MODELS, and scripts/check-muscle-map.py is what enforces it: a name that matches nothing colours nothing, silently, and the renderers cannot catch it because they only fail when a slug matches ZERO meshes in total — so one working name hides a broken one beside it. Two traps in the atlas's naming: a functional GROUP is often only an annotation (`Erector spinae` is a two-vertex label; the muscles are Iliocostalis/Longissimus/Spinalis by region), and many names carry a ' muscle' suffix that is easy to drop. Split muscles map to their parts/heads, which is where the geometry is. Bursae/sheaths/tendons/fascia are excluded from the lookup, so mapping to one colours nothing.
deltoid_posterior: Scapular spinal part of deltoid muscle
pectoralis_major: Clavicular head of pectoralis major muscle
Sternocostal head of pectoralis major muscle
wrist_extensors: Humeral head of extensor carpi ulnaris
Ulnar head of extensor carpi ulnaris
wrist_flexors: Humeral head of flexor carpi ulnaris
Ulnar head of flexor carpi ulnaris
